name: Tribe Community Platform
description: Tribe Community Platform was a hosted community product for branded discussions, spaces, members, engagement, and integrations. The same provider and product are now named Bettermode, so Tribe is retained only as a historical discovery alias.
agentUseSummary: Do not create a separate Tribe connection or install. Select Bettermode in Relay Marketplace; the converged Bettermode provider owns the current credentials, exact Network and member binding, bounded GraphQL tools, policies, runtime execution, and customer setup without duplicate authority or state.

blocked.label: Create a separate Tribe connection

blocked.label: Use a legacy Tribe API contract
blocked.description: Relay does not mount historical Tribe endpoints, schemas, tokens, SDKs, examples, or product names as a separate runtime surface.

blocked.label: Run separate Tribe agent actions
blocked.description: All supported current actions belong to Relay's typed, bounded Bettermode provider and its selected connection and policy.

approvalProfiles.label: Use Bettermode

providerSetup.blocker: Tribe Community Platform is the former name of Bettermode. Publishing or connecting it separately would create duplicate provider cards, credentials, installs, policies, and runtime authority.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep this historical slug non-installable and direct discovery, setup, connection, installation, and execution to the canonical Bettermode provider.
